integrity: Proof reconstructed from the definition of expansive observable, Theorem 1(bis) of arXiv:2510.17255v1, and the classical Menger--Nöbeling embedding theorem. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies finite jointly injective families of expansive observables; it does not resolve whether pseudoexpansivity alone implies pointwise expansivity or expansivity. The 2d+1 bound is a worst-case topological bound.
title: Finite expansive-observable certificates equal Euclidean embedding dimension
